crossRefs.note: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself…
About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
translations.bsb: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
translations.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
translations.asv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
